research_question: When does strictly past participant history harm current emotion recognition, how heavy is the upper tail, and do common context policies remain safe across frozen model families and datasets?

claim_boundary.primary_contribution: per-query paired history-harm distribution and tail-risk audit
not_claimed: first LLM for emotion recognition in conversations
psychological causal effect of personal history
claim_boundary.negative_result_value: The benchmark remains informative if every learned controller fails, provided the frozen multi-model harm audit and failure modes are reproduced.

data_contract.confirmation_rule: dataset-wise conjunction; a mean across two datasets cannot mask one-dataset failure
data_contract.development_roles: previously observed open roles; all development findings remain exploratory
data_contract.history_unit: same participant or speaker utterances with timestamp or turn strictly before the query

paired_estimands.eligible_population: queries with at least one strictly past permitted history item
paired_estimands.policy_population_regret: selected_times_query_regret averaged over all history-eligible queries
paired_estimands.conditional_regret: query regret conditional on the frozen policy selecting history

metric_contract.tail_definition: largest empirical 10 percent with fractional boundary mass; never values-greater-than-or-equal-to-quantile averaging
selection: classification metrics of the current-or-history hybrid

inference_contract.bootstrap: training seeds crossed with a dataset-wide shared whole-cluster draw
inference_contract.composite_cluster_encoding: typed tuple factorization; delimiter joining forbidden
inference_contract.multiple_comparisons: Holm-Bonferroni for the final predeclared primary family

provisional_claim_gate.candidate_requirement: At least two model families per dataset must show a non-trivial paired harm distribution under all-history and at least one additional frozen history strategy.
candidate_endpoints: cluster-CI lower bound for harm rate above a predeclared minimum
cluster-CI lower bound for p90 or CVaR90 above a practical threshold
directionally consistent replication in both datasets
provisional_claim_gate.reason_unfrozen: thresholds require outcome-free prospective sensitivity and an exact model roster

stages.outcomes: already observed roles only; explicitly exploratory
single canonical label load after all prelabel receipts pass
